::: {.content-visible when-format="docx"}
# Book_04 — Arc as the Identity Bridge
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Without Arc, the SQL Server engine has no cloud-native identity; without that identity, there is no Managed Identity to replace the AD service account and no mechanism to accept Entra ID-issued tokens. This book explains exactly what Arc does and does not change — and why SQL engine Entra auth (Layer 1) must not be blocked on the domain unjoin that OS-level Entra login (Layer 2) requires. (ADR-002)
:::
